rent: Weighted medians of positive gross rent; all move-in years; 80 replicate medians and SDR variance; 95% normal intervals. Valid point estimates stay visible; N<30 and high CV add cautions, not suppression. No geographic fallback. Missing uncertainty is explicit.
space: Independent share policy: valid weighted proportions with cell and group counts, group denominator and 80 replicate ratios. Small cells and high CV add cautions. None observed is not population absence and has no zero-width interval. Invalid denominator is unavailable.
reuse: NYC Rent Seekers figures and documentation: MIT. Third-party source data retains its source terms.
